Maya (CSM): need a 1-page quickstart for customers: warming, batching, streaming fallback, TTLs, and a short renewal-risk checklist. keep it copy-paste friendly.
Diego (SE): will do a tight checklist + two short examples (curl + JSON client config).
Diego (SE): Top 3 quick tips: prefill 30-90m before peak; batch 4-8 for latency-sensitive routes; enable streaming with a 2s client cutoff and server fallback.
Rhea (CS Ops): onboarding checklist (3 steps): 1) preflight health check (3 sample prompts), 2) 15m scheduled warmup, 3) share dashboard link and set basic alerts.
Sam (SRE): ops guard rails: circuit breaker on sustained 5xx >1% over 5m; queue + reject new requests for 30s after breaker trips; auto-fallback to verified low-latency model.
Diego (SE): sample client config (paste):
{ "batch_size": "8", "stream": "true", "prefill_minutes": "60", "cache_ttl_s": "1800", "retry_max": "3" }
Diego (SE): prefill curl (one-liner):
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"T123","prompts":["ping","summarize short","key points"]}'
Rhea (CS Ops): renewal-risk signals to watch (auto): usage_drop_pct > 30% week-over-week after day 14; prefill_success_rate < 90% during warmup; rising fallback_rate + customer quality reports.
AE-Bob: I'll use this in the kickoff email. can we get a single-slide PDF?
